1.context: Nicodemus searched the scriptures, but he did not understand spiritual matters. Knowledge of the subject matter is a must when it comes to Christian education. The second thing to look for in a teacher is good character. Jesus called the Pharisees and religious leaders of his time hypocrites, whitewashed tombs full of dead men's bones, and broods of vipers. Yes, they looked apart, but they were spiritually dead. He went on to say that the students should not follow what they do, but only listen to what they say.
